pr_title: statistics/handle/usage: add a collector utility based on channel to collect stats from sessions
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #50416

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

A new collector based on channel is implemented. It will be used to implement the index usage collector and replace other usage collectors in the future.

If you wonder how it will be used, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/50050 `pkg/statistics/handle/usage/indexusage/collector.go`.

Compared with the existing list implementation, the pros and cons:

Pros:

1. Every session manage the data structure locally. Most of the time they'll not need to be blocked.
2. Sending through channel is easier to maintain and keep safety / correctness.

Cons:

1. The global collector will lose the view of real time stats.

issue_context.title: usage stats collector refractor
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The original implementation of usage collector is not go-style enough, and the manually maintained linked-list can have some potential problem. We can refactor them into a channel (or two channel with priority), and maintain a unified worker to collect and merge all results.

review_comments: Is this timeout necessary? Could we just remove it and make it simpler?

After discussion, we agreed on hiding the argument `timeout`. (I also hide the argument `channelSize`).

I set a default value for them: timeout 5 minutes and channel size 10.
